C09-M01-L02-F1.title: Evidence classes in the Kestrel Freight intake
C09-M01-L02-F1.caption: Each evidence class has a different stability and a different earliest integrity anchor, shown against the fictional Kestrel items.
C09-M01-L02-F1.alt: Table with four columns: Class, Kestrel example, Stability and First integrity anchor. Physical item: E-01 laptop and E-02 USB drive, stable while sealed, anchored by seal number and photos. Physical document: E-05 printed spreadsheet, stable but fragile to handling, anchored by envelope and intake note. Provider export: E-03 mailbox archive, fixed at export time, anchored by the provider manifest hash. Provider export with no manifest: E-04 firewall CSV, fixed at export time, anchored only by the lab hash at intake. Full device image: a future image of E-01, fixed once verified, anchored by the hash at acquisition. Volatile state: none, because the laptop arrived powered off; lost at power-off; not available. Derived artefact: parsed timelines and extracts, recreatable from source, anchored by tool, version and source hash.
C09-M01-L02-F1.note: The first integrity anchor sets how far back the lab can vouch for an item's state.

C09-M01-L02-F2.title: One lab source, several generations: the acquisition transcript
C09-M01-L02-F2.caption: The course transcript as a provenance graph: each generation is linked to the forensic copy by the check recorded for it.
C09-M01-L02-F2.alt: Graph. suspect.dev, the source as labelled, has a solid arrow to evidence.dd, the forensic copy with SHA-256 e3a74e55...0f21 and 16,777,216 bytes, labelled stream hash matches source. evidence.dd has a solid arrow to working.dd, labelled copy verified: SHA-256 matches. working.dd has a solid arrow to working.dd after edit, SHA-256 16d816db...7f2c, labelled one byte changed at offset 100000. A dashed arrow from working.dd after edit to evidence.dd is labelled byte compare: differ at char 100001. A dashed arrow from evidence.dd to an MD5 digest node, 9330...2295, legacy compatibility only. A dashed arrow from working.dd to a derived artefacts node, which is the lesson's addition and not in the transcript.
C09-M01-L02-F2.note: A digest match links a generation to its anchor; it does not show the right source was chosen or unaltered before the first hash.
